independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG7 implementation, test, register row, ADR, repair (FE-C2, FE-C3, BE-R6, DO-K2, AN-P7E) or delivery decision in the reviewed candidate. In round 1 I raised F-DG7-913 and F-DG7-914; I verify them here as their originating reviewer, and I verify F-DG7-953 to 956 (reported by qa-verifier) as a non-author. The assignment file (sha256 9b7b46b9...eb501) was verified at the start and the end of the run. It says 'round: 7' in the record-format list, but the round directory, stages.json review_rounds and the validator (rec.round must equal the round-N directory) all say round 2, so this record uses round 2. I formed my verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-2 record, and I read none. I saw only that untracked code-security and qa round-2 evidence directories exist. All product data is SYNTHETIC. No retention change, Studio action or G1-G6 product decision in my runs approves anything real. Product G6 never implies DG7, and nothing here grants a business, Finance, IT or production approval. Code ran only in disposable clones under $TMPDIR (removed at the end) and on disposable PostgreSQL clusters in ports 32300-32399.

summary: FAIL. All six round-1 findings verified on candidate ca38b65e: F-DG7-913, 914, 953, 954, 955 and 956 are CLOSED_VERIFIED (see domain-reviewer.verifications.json). The five Retention screens are built and work on the real stack in English and Arabic. The BU PATCH regression tests kill the A26 defect. The handover test no longer pins a superseded report. The freeze commit holds no candidate file. One new Medium finding: F-DG7-915. The frozen docs/handover/release-notes.md was not regenerated after AN-P7E's register update, so release-notes --check exits 1, and the notes state the round-1 register SHA-256 (e4805087...) while the shipped register and About show fc8ece8b.... Per D-192 a Medium finding must be repaired before the gate. Independently, the D-249/D-270 protocol rows remain literally unmet and disclosed, for the release-auditor.
